articles.title: JWST Reveals Early Galaxies May Be 4x More Massive Than We Thought
articles.summary: JWST found that some early galaxies might be 4 times more massive than we thought. They hid tons of small stars behind bright ones, like houses behind skyscrapers!

articles.title: 2,200-Year-Old Shipwreck Reveals Ancient Waterproofing Secrets
articles.summary: A 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck reveals how they waterproofed ships with pine tar and beeswax. Pollen trapped in the goo shows where it was repaired!

articles.title: NASA's Astronaut Hub Prepares for Commercial Space Stations
articles.summary: NASA's Johnson Space Center is gearing up for commercial space stations! We toured Mission Control and saw how they're working with private companies like Blue Origin.
